    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.semilinear_pow_eq_one_of_compatible {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} [Field k] [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra k E] [Algebra k L] [Algebra E L] [IsScalarTower k E L] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] (σ : L ≃ₐ[k] L) (t : AddMonoid.End (TensorProduct k E V)) (u : AddMonoid.End (TensorProduct k L V)) (hs : ∀ (c : L) (z : TensorProduct k L V), u (c • z) = σ c • u z) (hc : ∀ (z : TensorProduct k E V), u ((TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k E L).toLinearMap LinearMap.id) z) = (TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k E L).toLinearMap LinearMap.id) (t z)) {n : ℕ} (ht : t ^ n = 1) (hσ : σ ^ n = 1) :
    u ^ n = 1

    If the original semilinear map and the larger field automorphism both have period dividing n, then the extended semilinear map does too.
